description: Deprecated alias of search_providers. Browse published provider and media profiles by name, category and review status. Results are paginated, desk-reviewed first and then alphabetical. Use get_provider for sourced facts; media profiles are not rated as providers.

category.description: Exact provider category; media selects publication profiles.

limit.description: Records per page, from 1 to 20 (default 10). Use page to continue; total_items and total_pages describe all matches.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1, maximum 500). Keep filters and limit unchanged while paging; stop at total_pages. A page beyond the results returns an empty items array.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring in name or summary; omit to browse.

review_status.description: Editorial review status, not independent claim verification.

title: Search suppliers (deprecated)
